{"question":{"id":"q05","question":"苏天晴第一次变身是怎样触发的？喊变身词有反应吗？","readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"group":"ordinary","category":"rule","expected":"她喊多种变身词时十字星没反应；后来把拇指摁进十字星中央凹陷，光芒笼罩客厅，提示初次变身已完成。","certainty":"supported","evidence":[{"chapter":2,"paragraph":57,"quote":"狐狐嗓子都快喊哑了，脑子里能想到的变身词全喊了一遍，却仍是没见手中这枚十字星有丁点动静。"},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":63,"quote":"试探着将拇指摁了进去"},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":64,"quote":"光芒顷刻间笼罩了客厅。"},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66,"quote":"【初次变身，已完成】"}]},"answer":{"queries":5,"sourceQueries":5,"exhausted":true,"answer":{"text":"苏天晴第一次变身不是由喊变身词触发的。她拿到金色十字星后，曾反复喊“变身！”“魔法少女变身！”等能想到的变身词，喊到嗓子快哑了，十字星也毫无动静。真正的触发方式是她发现十字星中间有一个刚好能容纳一只手指的凹陷，于是试探着把拇指按了进去；随即光芒笼罩客厅，一瞬后白光消失，她感到身体各处传来轻盈触感，脑海响起【初次变身，已完成】。因此，喊变身词没有反应，按入十字星凹陷才触发了首次变身。","status":"answered","recordIds":["source-c02"],"sources":[{"chapter":2,"paragraph":42},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":50},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":52},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":53},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":57},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":63},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":64},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":65},{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"query":"变身"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"query":"苏天晴"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"from":1,"to":40}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":42,"text":"材质不明的金色十字星，做工蛮精致，手感扎实，不像是塑料玩具，这个应该就是魔法少女们必备的变身道具了吧。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":47,"text":"魔法少女变身！穿着华丽的洋装在城市间穿梭飞行与怪人战斗！这具身体的原主人也曾经梦想过这种场面！"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":50,"text":"“变……变身！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":52,"text":"嗯？不对吗？变身不是这么喊的？还是说要加点什么前缀？"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":53,"text":"“魔法少女变身！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":57,"text":"狐狐嗓子都快喊哑了，脑子里能想到的变身词全喊了一遍，却仍是没见手中这枚十字星有丁点动静。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":58,"text":"不是，你这秘典都不给点新手指引的吗，别人拿到系统多少都有个新手任务好伐，至少教我怎么变身嘛！"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":61,"text":"也没见这上面有写字呀，到底要怎么才能变身呢。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":66,"text":"【初次变身，已完成】"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":9,"returned":9},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":6,"text":"吐掉嘴里的牙膏泡沫，苏天晴默默放下手中那只可爱的猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬起脑袋看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":17,"text":"与镜中的自己对视了半晌，苏天晴猛然察觉到自己这样的举动很像个变泰，脸颊微红，轻咳两声收敛发癫的状态，开始认真审视起自己身体中残留的记忆。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人就叫苏天晴，这里与自己曾经的世界相差无几，但却是人类与兽人共存的一个世界。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":20,"text":"虽然名义上共存，但兽人数量远远不及人类，苏天晴从小便独自一人孤独地长大，虽然模样可爱但社恐孤僻，好在有兽人互助协会的资助顺利考上蓉城最好的医学院，却又在临近开学时染上一场兽人流感，熬夜过程中突发了暴发性心肌炎……"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":23,"text":"想到这，苏天晴不由得感觉胸口幻痛，连忙伸手去揉了揉。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":25,"text":"简单洗漱了一遍，苏天晴踩着不合脚的大拖鞋走到客厅，一边躺上沙发，一边顺手从茶几上拿起刚才那本跟自己说话的古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":30,"text":"揣着一丝侥幸，苏天晴举起手中这本古书，翻开扉页。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":33,"text":"一枚金色十字星从书里掉出，狠狠砸在毫无防备的苏天晴脸上。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":46,"text":"把金色十字星拎在手里把玩了半晌，比起那个莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对这枚所谓的“守护之星”倒是更感兴趣，眼中甚至逐渐放出光彩。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":63,"text":"盯着十字星中间那枚刚好能容纳下一只手指的凹陷看了半晌，苏天晴试探着将拇指摁了进去。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":10,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":66},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":1,"text":"第2章
